description: This is a traditional Persian-style rug with a rich red base and intricate floral patterns in cream, gold, blue, and green. The central field is densely populated with stylized flowers and foliage, creating a classic and elegant look. It features a prominent border with a repeating motif, framing the central design. The rug appears to be made of wool or a similar natural fiber, giving it a soft texture and a luxurious feel. It's laid out on a paved stone surface, suggesting it might be used for outdoor decoration or to temporarily air out.
